descriptions.text: Figure 2.9 box plot: planetary pressures index (2022) by HDI group. The median (central line) rises at each group: Low is about 0.01, Medium about 0.03, High about 0.05, and Very high about 0.12. Thus the Very high HDI group has the highest median. Source crop: physical PDF page 71, Figure 2.9.

descriptions.text: Figure 1.9 has two box plots across Low, Medium, High and Very high HDI groups. Left: 2022 planetary-pressure index, increasing with HDI group. descriptions.text: Table 3.1, Recommendations for improving provision of different types of global public goods. Best-shot (example: scientific breakthrough): likely provided if incentives are strong enough for the best shooter to contribute; rich or dominant country fosters provision, but multilateral institutions can pool actions or coordinate multiple potential best shooters. Summation (example: climate change mitigation): tendency toward underprovision from free/easy riding because contributions are perfectly substitutable; grants and loans foster fairness and multilateral institutions monitor and track contributions. Weakest-link (example: pandemic disease control): more likely provided if interests align; capacity building is essential to enhance contributions of the least able and to redistribute capacity among countries. Source crop: physical PDF page 91, Table 3.1.
descriptions.source: UNDP Human Development Report 2023/24, English edition
